outcome: incidence of malignant neoplasm of the placenta
cohort: 370,117 women with at least one pregnancy (GTD, ectopic pregnancy, abortion, or delivery) from the Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service/National Inpatient Sample (HIRA-NIS) in South Korea between 2009 and 2015
finding: The overall incidence rates of GTD and HM in South Korea were 1.3 and 1.1 per 1,000 pregnancies, respectively, remaining stable from 2009 to 2015, with age significantly affecting the incidence but not socioeconomic status.
